label: Long Point 8.5 cm
description: The Long Point collar is defined by its dramatic 8.5cm points that angle sharply downward, creating a narrow spread that frames a tie knot with patrician authority. Originating from mid-century American and British tailoring traditions, it conveys formality and a distinctly traditional sensibility that pairs best with a four-in-hand or half-Windsor knot. On the shirt, it reads as elongated and commanding, adding vertical emphasis to the chest and making the wearer appear taller and more formal.
